name: wavespeed-cli
description: Generate and edit AI media (image, video, audio, 3D) on WaveSpeed through its hosted MCP server and a CLI skill for local files, batches, live catalog search and price quotes.

interface.shortDescription: AI image, video, audio and 3D generation from Codex — every model on WaveSpeed is one call.
interface.longDescription: Adds WaveSpeed to Codex through the hosted WaveSpeed MCP server, authorized once in the browser, and a skill for the open-source wavespeed CLI. Generate, edit and extend images and videos, run any model, inspect schemas, and check prices and balance. The hosted server accepts public URLs; use the CLI with @path for local files. CLI authentication uses wavespeed login separately.
defaultPrompt: Generate a 16:9 hero image of a cyberpunk skyline at golden hour.
Animate ./hero.jpg into a 5-second clip with subtle parallax.
Replace the background of ./product.png with a sunlit kitchen, then quote the cost first.
